title: Pantone Color Bridge Guide Set - Coated & Uncoated (GP6102A)

writeup: Pantone's Color Bridge Guide Set (GP6102A) pairs coated and uncoated fan decks that translate Pantone spot colors into CMYK, HTML and RGB values. Woot has it new for $199.99, while The Printers Shopper lists the same GP6102A set at $370. This is the edition before the current GP6102B.
